segments.text: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Then said I, Whither goest thou?
And he said unto me,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof,
and

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: what is the length thereof.
And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
And said unto him,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: For I, saith the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: ¶ Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north,
saith the LORD:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven,
saith the LORD.

segments.speaker: Prophet
segments.text: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
For thus saith the LORD of hosts;

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.

segments.speaker: The LORD of hosts
segments.text: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: ¶ Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee,
saith the LORD.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto thee.
And the LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.

segments.speaker: Prophet
segments.text: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.

footnotes: his…: Heb. the habitation of his holiness
